children.characters: Let’s go camping!! —although, let’s be honest, it was just another excuse to test ride the bike some more and find the perfect spot for my cameras. Back at the workshop, we had to make some decisions about the front end of the bike and the lights. The suspension also got a much-needed service by an amazing expert. And between all these tests, I took the bike to the Netherlands to sort out the license plate. Busy days, but things are coming together! 💪
